On a roller coaster ride, passengers travel in carriages around a track.

On the ride, carriages complete multiple circuits of the track such that

• the maximum vertical height of a carriage above the ground is 60 m

• a carriage starts a circuit at a vertical height of 2 m above the ground

• the ground is horizontal

The vertical height, \( H \, 	ext{m} \), of a carriage above the ground, \( t \) seconds after the carriage starts the first circuit, is modelled by the equation

\[ H = a - b(t - 20)^2 \]

where \( a \) and \( b \) are positive constants.

questions.label: (a)
questions.question_text: Find a complete equation for the model.

questions.label: (b)
questions.question_text: Use the model to determine the height of the carriage above the ground when \( t = 40 \)

questions.label: (c)
questions.question_text:
Find a complete equation for the alternative model.

In an alternative model, the vertical height, \( H \, 	ext{m} \), of a carriage above the ground, \( t \) seconds after the carriage starts the first circuit, is given by

\[ H = 29 \cos(9t + a^\circ) + \beta \quad \quad 0 \leq a < 360^\circ \]

where \( a \) and \( \beta \) are constants.

questions.label: (d)
questions.question_text:
Given that the carriage moves continuously for 2 minutes,

give a reason why the alternative model would be more appropriate.

where \( A \) and \( B \) are constants to be found.

questions.label: (b)
questions.question_text:
Hence show that the \( x \) coordinates of the turning points of the curve are solutions of the equation
\[ x = \frac{2e^{3x} - 4}{e^{3x} + 4} \]

The equation \( x = \frac{2e^{3x} - 4}{e^{3x} + 4} \) has two positive roots \( \alpha \) and \( \beta \), where \( \beta > \alpha \).
